visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair wearing a pink t-shirt walks along a sidewalk under a covered walkway toward a FamilyMart store entrance. She turns around to smile at the camera while holding her backpack straps. (2) Indoors, in a bright studio-like living room, the woman stands behind a table holding two beverage products: a bottle of herb drink and a carton of fresh milk. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand pouring thick dark herb jelly liquid from a bottle into a white bowl, followed by pouring white fresh milk over it. (4) The woman is seen sitting on a sofa, tasting the mixed herb jelly and milk with a silver spoon, looking satisfied with a slight smile. (5) A top-down close-up view shows a spoon stirring the herb jelly and milk mixture, revealing the texture of the jelly and wood ear pieces. (6) The woman holds up a bottle of plum juice and a bottle of sparkling water. (7) She pours the dark plum juice into a rectangular glass container and places it in a freezer drawer. (8) After freezing, she pours clear sparkling water over the frozen plum juice and uses a spoon to break it into a slushy texture. (9) She tastes the plum slushy with a spoon and gestures 'OK' with her fingers while looking happy. (10) She holds up a pink package of noodles and a large green bottle of soy milk in her kitchen. (11) A pot of boiling water is shown on an induction stove; noodles are cooked, drained, and then returned to a pot containing boiling soy milk and sauce. (12) Broccoli and carrots are added to the creamy noodle soup in the pot. (13) The woman sits at a wooden dining table, eating the noodles and drinking the soup from a large bowl, expressing enjoyment through facial expressions. (14) She moves the camera to reveal a young man sitting at the table eating a small cup of herb jelly; they have a brief, humorous interaction before he walks away with his food.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator throughout; 1 male character appearing at the end.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Young Asian woman with brown bob-cut hair, wearing a light pink oversized t-shirt and matching shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Starts outside a FamilyMart convenience store under a sidewalk corridor. Transitions to a modern, bright apartment interior with a light-colored sofa, white walls, and a well-lit kitchen featuring an induction stove and wooden dining table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a cheerful and high-arousal tone over an upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM. A subtle sound of walking footsteps is audible. (2) As the scene transitions to a demonstration, the sound of liquid splashing into a bowl is clearly heard, followed by a metallic 'clink' of a spoon hitting ceramics. (3) The female voice maintains a consistent narrative pace, explaining the food combinations while a soft 'pop' sound effect accentuates a visual text appearing. (4) In the kitchen segment, the sound of water boiling and a mechanical click of an induction stove being turned on are present. A distinct 'slurp' sound effect occurs when she eats the noodles. (5) Toward the end, the audio shifts to a more conversational style as a male voice enters, exhibiting a casual and playful tone. The BGM remains constant but ducks slightly under their dialogue.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Demonstration 1 -> Demonstration 2 -> Demonstration 3 -> Interaction/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and demonstrate creative 'hidden' ways to prepare and consume products from the brand 'Shuang Yue' (雙月) found at FamilyMart convenience stores, aiming to engage food-loving viewers with simple DIY recipes.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of branded products, multiple recipes featuring only those products, and a verbal call to purchase at FamilyMart.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy social media editing style with bright colors and rapid cuts to maintain viewer engagement. The combination of food tutorial and lifestyle vlog elements makes the endorsement feel organic.
